text:
Aisha: Quick sync — planning the Optimize advisor roadmap for batching/caching/quant + eval-triggered alerts. Need concrete launch lanes (Pilot/Beta/GA), minimal acceptance criteria per lane, and which customer-driven slices to prioritize. Proposal: Pilot=field test with 2 customers, Beta=self-serve with docs + lightweight UI, GA=SLA + tenant controls. Thoughts?

Ben: +1 to the lanes. Narrow q: what are the minimum telemetry/eval signals we need to support eval-triggered alerts? is 1k eval samples reasonable for a pilot? Also need to know runtime constraints for adaptive batching.

Chen: For eval alerts, recommend 500-2k samples depending on variance. Practical acceptance thresholds for pilot: avg token-cost reduction >= 15% vs baseline AND semantic delta < 1% (we can use application-level metric, e.g., top-1 accuracy or rouge depending on workload). We should require model-agnostic recs (i.e., work across CPU/GPU, quantized models).

Diego: Operational flags: Pilot must run on Dedicated only (no hosted SLA), and allow quick rollback to safe config. We need autoscale test plan for continuous batching (simulated QPS spike). Canary rollout plan: 5% traffic -> 25% -> 100%. Also add quota guard rails so batching doesn't starve small tenants.

Elena: From field: customers care about two things first — explainability (why a quant/batch suggestion was made) and per-tenant opt-out. They will also want a preview UI that shows estimated token savings + estimated quality impact before accepting a recommendation.

Frank: Prioritization rubric suggestion: score by expected unit savings (cost delta * invocations), risk (potential quality regression), and customer ARR. Use weighted sum: 40% savings, 40% risk reduction, 20% customer priority. That will help pick first pilot customers.

Aisha: Decision proposal: Pilot with 2 customers (one chat-heavy, one embedding-heavy). Gate for Pilot -> Beta: no >1 customer-facing regression > 1% or >3 incidents in pilot, and at least 15% median token-cost improvement for pilot workloads. Gate Beta -> GA: multi-tenant self-serve UI, audit logs, tenant opt-out, and SLI targets met for 30d. Owners?

Ben: I can own runtime integration + canary automation. Will add an autoscale test harness.

Chen: I'll define eval thresholds and build the eval-trigger config + tests. Draft config example below for discussion:
```
eval_trigger:
  name: perf_regression
  min_samples: 500
  window: 7d
  metrics:
    - name: app_quality_delta
      threshold: 0.01  # absolute drop in app-level metric allowed
    - name: token_cost_reduction
      threshold: 0.15  # require at least 15% cost saving
```

Diego: FYI infra constraints: caching TTLs per-tenant will need a policy (default 24h) + eviction hints. If we expose caching recommendations, ensure KMS/HSM keys for any on-prem cache encryption in Private mode.

Elena: I will compile customer pilot list and their acceptance metrics (will DM the list). Also suggested messaging for customers: we position this as "cost-savings advisor" with opt-in and preview.

deploy-bot: Deployment queued: branch=optimize-advisor/pilot-config commit=3f9a7d -> staging. CI results: 12/12.

Aisha: Next steps: 1) Ben + Chen draft pilot plan (infra + eval config) by Thu EOD, 2) Elena to confirm 2 pilot customers by Fri, 3) Diego to provide canary + autoscale checklist. I'll schedule a 30m decision huddle Mon 10am. Agenda: lanes, gate thresholds, pilot owners. @Elena pls bring the customer list. :thumbsup:

Ben: :+1: schedule works for me.

Chen: ack.

Diego: ack, will add SLO targets to the checklist.

Frank: will prep prioritization spreadsheet and share before the huddle.

Aisha: thanks all — keeping this lean. If anyone has a strong objection to the gates above speak now or we'll lock them in at the huddle.
